install_steps: sudo apt-get install -y fping || sudo dnf install -y fping || brew install fping
note: Packaged in virtually every distro: apt (fping), dnf (fping), apk (fping), pacman (fping), brew (fping). Source builds from https://github.com/schweikert/fping/releases. Requires raw-socket privileges (setuid or cap_net_raw are set automatically by packages).
